metadata.title: Printing Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing printing services that preserve confidentiality, identity attribution, and accountability when digital information is physically released.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Enterprise printing services, network printers, multifunction devices, print servers, and print job management systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing baseline trust assumptions for institutional printing as a data egress mechanism.

metadata.remarks: Printing Core defines the foundational trust properties required to treat printing as a controlled and accountable transformation of digital content into physical artifacts. This pattern establishes identity awareness, boundary control, and auditability without addressing secure release mechanisms or data classification.

components.title: Print Job Identity Attribution
components.description: Ensures print jobs are attributable to authenticated and accountable identities.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading or misattribution of print job origin.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to print without accountability.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding for printing actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Print job submission is attributable to authenticated identities.
Identity attributes support correct attribution of print jobs.

components.title: Printing Boundary and Access Control
components.description: Constrains who may submit print jobs and access printing devices.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Misuse of trusted internal access paths to retrieve printed output.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control to restrict printing capabilities to authorized users.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to printing services is explicitly managed and reviewed.
Printing privileges follow least privilege principles.

components.title: Print Artifact Confidentiality
components.description: Reduces the risk of unintended exposure of printed materials.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of sensitive information from unattended or misdirected printouts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Data access control and handling practices to protect printed output.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controls reduce the risk of inappropriate disclosure of printed information.

components.title: Printing Observability and Accountability
components.description: Provides auditability and traceability of printing activity.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Destruction or suppression of evidence related to printing misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Printing events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports oversight of printing activity.
